newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Garuda says continuing Airbus operations.
newsitem.headline: Garuda says continuing Airbus operations.

text.p: Indonesia's national flag carrier PT Garuda Indonesia was continuing flights with its six Airbus Industrie A330-300 aircraft despite despite concerns in Hong Kong over Rolls Royce Trent 700 engines, Garuda said on Monday.
Hong Kong airlines Cathay Pacific Airways Ltd and Dragonair have grounded their total 15 A330-300 aircraft on concerns over engine safety and have cancelled many flights.
"We are continuing to operate our Airbuses. We have same type of Trent 700 but there are differences," Garuda spokesman Arief Hartanto told Reuters.

"There is also no mandatory order (to ground the aircraft) from the aircraft maker or from the engine maker. We will definitely ground the planes if we receive such an order," he added. He said Garuda had so far experienced no problems.
Hartanto said Garuda had six Airbus A330-300s operating on flights only within Asia.
